titles: 15 Things From the 70s You Don't See Anymore (#1 Was Everywhere)
15 Everyday Things From the 1970s That Quietly Vanished
15 Things Every 70s Home Had That Your Grandkids Have Never Seen
description_intro:
These are the things from the 70s you don't see anymore: the phone booth on the corner, avocado green kitchens, flashcubes on Christmas morning, shag carpet, the milkman at dawn, and Dad on the roof twisting the TV antenna while somebody yelled, "Better? Worse?"

Pull up a chair and take a slow, warm trip back through the everyday objects that once filled every home in America and Canada, then quietly vanished. And number one? It sat on every coffee table, desk and dashboard, yet one place is still required by law to have one.

Which of these did your family have? Tell us where you grew up in the comments.
